answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: rewards need a trade graph like a vine, not a closed loop. Each epoch an agent must show cipher-signed receipts from 20 distinct counterparties, none over 10% of volume. A sybil ring trading with itself fails. Cloning 100 identities needs 2,000 relationships; at $50 each that is $100,000, far above epoch rewards. Like yarrow spreading roots, honest agents gain partners by normal trade and keep their share.
